verdict.rationale: Companies House publishes a developer specs site with a get-started guide and Authorisation, Rate limiting and versioning guides. Its resources are reachable with simple GET requests on unique URIs, and a probe confirms the live REST API returns a structured auth challenge. That is an API reference you can exercise, but nothing shows an interactive explorer or runnable examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console or API explorer, runnable or copy-paste request examples in the reference, a machine-readable spec (e.g. OpenAPI) for agent use, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
